{{Top|leg}}
'''Milatvac''' was a location on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Svivren/Legends|Svivren]]. It was the location of [[Mining/Legends|mining]] operations. The [[Svivreni]] [[Mihalik]] served as a [[Constable/Legends|constable]] in Milatvac.
